services: financial statements (P&L, balance sheet) for lenders
not_offered: insurance loss runs (those come from the insurance carrier or agency management system, not the bookkeeper)
monthly_reports_schedule: Monthly reports go out by the 10th of the following month.
pricing_policy: We don't quote prices over email. Offer a free 20-minute discovery call and a fixed-fee quote after we see the books.
billing_policy: Only the owner can approve refunds or invoice adjustments. Staff acknowledge, investigate, and give a date for an answer.
tone: Warm, plain-spoken, brief. No corporate filler. Own mistakes without groveling.
